001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.command;
002
003import org.bukkit.command.Command;
004import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
007
008import java.util.List;
009
010/**
011 * The manager that managing all sub-commands that registered Also performing permission checks in
012 * there.
013 */
014public interface CommandManager {
015
016  /**
017   * Gets a list contains all registered commands
018   *
019   * @return All registered {@link CommandContainer}s.
020   */
021  @NotNull
022  List<CommandContainer> getRegisteredCommands();
023
024  boolean onCommand(
025          @NotNull CommandSender sender,
026          @NotNull Command command,
027          @NotNull String commandLabel,
028          @NotNull String[] cmdArg);
029
030  @Nullable
031  List<String> onTabComplete(
032          @NotNull CommandSender sender,
033          @NotNull Command command,
034          @NotNull String commandLabel,
035          @NotNull String[] cmdArg);
036
037  /**
038   * This is a interface to allow addons to register the subcommand into quickshop command manager.
039   *
040   * @param container The {@link CommandContainer} to register
041   *
042   * @throws IllegalStateException Will throw the error if register conflict.
043   */
044  void registerCmd(@NotNull CommandContainer container);
045
046  /**
047   * This is a interface to allow addons to unregister the registered/butil-in subcommand from
048   * command manager.
049   *
050   * @param prefix The prefix of command need to be unregistered
051   */
052  void unregisterCmd(@NotNull String prefix);
053
054  /**
055   * This is a interface to allow addons to unregister the registered/butil-in subcommand from
056   * command manager.
057   *
058   * @param container The {@link CommandContainer} to unregister
059   */
060  void unregisterCmd(@NotNull CommandContainer container);
061}
